values.FROZEN_EXTERNAL_REVIEW: Content/claim surface intentionally frozen while awaiting external review or replication.
values.ACTIVE_EXPERIMENTAL_RESEARCH: Active experimental work with evidence restricted to stated tested scope.
values.ACTIVE_ENGINEERING: Active engineering work with implemented/tested components but no implication of scientific novelty.
values.ACTIVE_CREATIVE_TECHNOLOGY: Active creative/interactive technology project, separate from scientific evidence claims.
values.ACTIVE_PROTOTYPE: Usable/implemented prototype still subject to interface, behavior, or validation changes.
values.ACTIVE_CREATIVE_PROTOTYPE: Implemented creative prototype still evolving as a product or experience.
values.WORK_IN_PROGRESS: Incomplete project; implementation, documentation, behavior, or validation may materially change.
values.LEGACY: Preserved historical implementation that is no longer the preferred current entry point.
values.ARCHIVE: Historical/provenance collection; not a current evidence-bearing claim surface.
values.UPSTREAM_DERIVED: Repository whose base project/code/research authorship belongs to upstream authors; local work should be evaluated as a diff.

note: Maturity describes repository state/presentation. It does not establish scientific truth, novelty, quality, safety, or external validation.
